featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh B
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited Jayraj in India during the initial designing my custom built house in Maryland (USA). Jayraj was very professional, he noted down all of my requirements such as members who currently live in the house, marital status, health and other key factors. He used all of that information to help me build my house by conforming to all of the Vastu principles.  He was detailed in his analysis to the extent of what number my house should be, days I should start the construction, where excavation should start from, where the utility lines should be entering and exiting the house. This is in addition to him helping choose the best places for each bedroom, bathroom and other rooms in the house.  It took almost a year to build the house and since that time, my family and I have felt the positive vibrations and energy since living here.  In addition, I have progressed exponentially into the business of my choice.  I highly recommend anyone who is building a house or planning to buy a house to consult with Jayraj throughout the process.  He does a great job of explaining the pros and cons of each decision and is available to answer questions through out the process.
